abstract_sentences.text: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success in dyadic (one-on-one) instruction, they face significant challenges in One-to-Many alignment, such as clinical ward rounds, where an instructor must simultaneously guide a diverse group of trainees.
Current models often suffer from context dilution and goal misalignment, failing to balance individual scaffolding with collective learning progress.
To address this, we introduce ClinEdu, a multi-agent pedagogical simulator that models the complexity of group dynamics.

Leveraging this platform, we construct ClinTeach, a large-scale dataset of Socratic teaching dialogues, and propose ClinTutor-R1, the first vision-language agent explicitly architected to achieve one-to-many alignment in clinical education, employing an explicit internal thinking mechanism to model both individual belief states and group consensus.

evidence.anchor: individual belief states and group consensus

abstract_sentences.text: We validate our framework through a comprehensive protocol covering static benchmarks, in-situ interactive evaluation within ClinEdu, expert assessment, and a 200-participant real user study.

Experimental results demonstrate that ClinTutor-R1 outperforms base models by over 20% and achieves parity with proprietary models, while exhibiting scalability in maintaining instructional quality across expanding student cohorts.

experimental_design.name: MedXpertQA split
experimental_design.description: 4,460 USMLE-style questions across 17 specialties; 230 text-only and 230 vision-language test instances, with approximately 4K remaining for training.

experimental_design.name: MVME evaluation
experimental_design.description: MVME has 506 real-world doctor-patient consultation records and the full dataset is used for testing.

experimental_design.name: baseline families
experimental_design.description: Foundation models include LLaVA, Qwen2.5VL, InternVL, o3, GPT-4o, and DeepSeek-R1; medical-education agents include EduChat-R1, TutorRL, DRLTutor, and Med-SocraticLM.

experimental_design.name: automated interactive evaluation
experimental_design.description: GPT-4.1 judge scores ETS, MSM, and MPS on a 1–10 scale; 100 random cases are re-scored by Gemini 3 Pro and GPT-5.

experimental_design.name: human expert evaluation
experimental_design.description: Three medical-education experts rate 100 anonymized multi-turn dialogues on three dimensions with a 10-point Likert scale.

experimental_design.name: real user study
experimental_design.description: 200 medical students from junior undergraduates through senior interns rate IQ, IE, and OR after online-demo interaction.

experimental_design.name: scalability design
experimental_design.description: The study varies group size from 1 to 10 students and reports ETS/MSM/MPS/Avg at 1, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10.

experimental_design.name: robustness design
experimental_design.description: Student agents are LLaVA, QwenVL, InternVL, DeepSeek-R1, GPT-4o, and a heterogeneous mixture.

experimental_design.name: controlled error injection
experimental_design.description: 300 clinical cases use groups of four; one error type is injected into a randomly selected student agent and CSR requires immediate next-turn acknowledgment and revision.

evidence.anchor: 300 clinical cases with groups of four

experimental_design.name: training configuration
experimental_design.description: SFT uses Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, LlamaFactory, LoRA r=8, two H800 GPUs and 8 hours; GRPO RL uses four H800 GPUs, 150 steps and about 10 hours.

experimental_design.name: random seeds and leakage audit
experimental_design.description: The PDF reports three independent runs for Table 2 but does not identify seeds, split IDs, or a separate leakage audit.

experimental_design.name: pre-registered research questions
experimental_design.description: Sections 4–5 contain no explicit RQ or preregistration statement.

claim_closure.claim: ClinEdu and ClinTeach supply a scalable environment and 48k-scale dialogue resource for one-to-many training.
claim_closure.method_response: Question decomposition, persona-script decoupling, multiple agents, and interaction protocol are specified.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Table 5 gives 48,484 dialogues and the experiments run in ClinEdu.

claim_closure.claim: Explicit individual/group thinking and rubric RL balance individual scaffolding with collective progress.
claim_closure.method_response: Tags and three-axis reward/veto give a concrete mechanism.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Thinking/RL/reward and agent-component ablations report score changes.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Conclusion repeats internal thinking and reinforcement learning.

claim_closure.claim: ClinTutor-R1 exceeds its base model by over 20% and is competitive with proprietary models in the study evaluations.
claim_closure.method_response: Sections 3–4 specify the model training and evaluation protocol.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Tables 2, 4, and 6 report the relevant benchmark, expert/user, and multi-judge values.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Conclusion restates the reported improvement and competitiveness.

claim_closure.claim: The method scales to 10 students with practical latency.
claim_closure.method_response: The tutor creates per-student analyses and a group synthesis; Algorithm 1 defines N-student loop.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Table 11 provides quality scores at 1–10 students, but no latency table/protocol is supplied.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Conclusion says the model scales effectively.

claim_closure.claim: ClinTutor-R1 is the first vision-language agent for this one-to-many clinical-education task.
claim_closure.method_response: The paper defines a vision-language tutor with text/static-image scope.
claim_closure.evidence_response: No priority-check experiment can establish literature-first status.

claim_closure.claim: The tutor maintains clinical safety and professionalism.
claim_closure.method_response: Specialist/Safety review and CS reward/veto operationalize the claim.
claim_closure.evidence_response: MPS rubric, controlled-error CSR, expert ratings, and limitation/impact boundaries provide evidence within simulation and study settings.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Impact/Ethics restrict the system to educational simulation.

limitations.name: simulator realism
limitations.description: Persona, cognitive-bias, and group-conflict injection cannot fully capture emotional, noisy, and environmentally complex real wards.

evidence.anchor: cannot fully capture the emotional, noisy

limitations.name: modality scope
limitations.description: Vision-language is scoped to text and static medical images, excluding auscultation audio, physical-exam signals, procedure video, and ambient ward interactions.

limitations.name: longitudinal learning
limitations.description: The 200-student study is a short-term interaction study; longitudinal trials are needed for durable learning gains and clinical-reasoning behavior.

limitations.name: latency and tokens
limitations.description: Explicit internal thinking increases generated tokens and approximately linear latency growth with student number.

limitations.name: deployment boundary
limitations.description: The system is strictly designed for educational simulation, not treating real patients.

limitations.name: future multimodal work
limitations.description: The paper calls for ethically approved real-world audiovisual ward-round data and future real-time audio/video streams.

final_judgment.single_storyline: 把 one-to-many clinical Socratic tutoring 写成个体 belief states 与 group consensus 的同步对齐问题，再以 ClinEdu/ClinTeach、explicit thinking、three-axis reward 和 review loop 构成训练—评测链。[p.2–5]
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 主文保留问题、系统组件、reward/veto、核心设计、主表、尺度/鲁棒性/CSR 与 Limitation；全量 prompts、judge rubrics、hyperparameters 和 transcript 在附录。[p.5–10; p.14–49]
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Appendix C、F、G、H、J 承担训练配置、interaction flow、judge criterion、cross-judge robustness 与 CSR 实作。主链可从正文理解，复现审计需要附录。[p.14–19]
final_judgment.best_pattern: Fig. 1 先把问题和 scaling 承诺压缩为视觉对象，Fig. 2 紧接着把它展开为 agent loop，Table 2 并置主比较与 component deletion，Eqs. (1)–(3) 使 reward/veto 可检查。[p.1; p.3; p.5; p.7]
final_judgment.largest_gap: 当前设计未直接闭合 real-world ward fidelity、durable learning gains、latency measurement protocol 或 live multimodal deployment；最后一项限制由作者明说，latency protocol 为 uncertain。[p.10; p.23]
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 为异质群体交互分别显化 individual state、group state 和 domain safety，并让每一对象在方法、训练 criterion 和受控评测中对应出现。[p.4–7]
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 迁移到法律、工程或编程等领域时，第三安全轴必须按目标领域的专家标准与验证数据重建，不能直接复制 clinical safety rubric。[p.15–16, Appendix E]

lexical_rhetoric.counting_boundary: These are direct-string counts in pp. 1–10. Raw token frequency is left to the aggregate script; appendix prompt templates would inflate agent/student tokens.
